title: house.toml [jobs]
description: One table per job, [jobs.<id>], with <id> matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$. At most one of every, at and cron; a job with none runs only by hand. outputs are path prefixes the job may create files under; mutates are existing files it may replace. Paths are relative to the house, written with forward slashes, and never enter .git. Constraints the schema subset cannot state (argv not empty, a valid cron string, one schedule key) are checked by core/lib/governance/jobs.js.
